name: Feature request

**What are you trying to do that you can't do today?**

**Does it fit the four rules?** (see CONTRIBUTING.md)

- [ ] It does not replace the host agent
- [ ] It does not require a fifth MCP tool — or it explains why a kernel symbol
      will not work
- [ ] It does not write outside the projection delimiter block

**How would you know it worked?** A measurable criterion is worth more than a
description.
